entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...So that was another of Dr. Maruki's[n]memories?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, I believe so. It seemed to be a much[n]more recent memory than the first one[n]we saw, though...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, after the incident with his girlfriend,[n]he progressed in his research to harness[n]cognitive psience as a healing practice...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: However, his research was shut down,[n]and his career along with it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All he had left was his resolve to prove[n]his research valid, then use it to save[n]people...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That seems to be the message delivered[n]by the videos we've found.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: It must have been his dream... To use his[n]research to save people here...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If that sounds good to you, would you[n]prefer we just turn around and go home?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, what she says. If anything, we've[n]gotta pull out all the stops to win this one.
